TestSafeExtract::test_rejects_hardlink.reason: FioriVoce's update archive is a Zip64 file, which has no hard links (docs/port/differences.md a34-archive; docs/port/packages/M10.md change 2). The link a zip can carry is refused: tests/update_native/test_archive.cpp, section "a declared file is a symbolic link".

TestSafeExtract::test_rejects_parent_mem.note: case: the archive is independently checked against every declared hash, section "a member climbs out of the candidate"

TestPreserveAndEligibility::test_preserv.note: case: native preparation preserves Inno metadata and stages the installed helper. The uninstaller half only: the legacy NVIDIA tree is engine-specific and has no counterpart (M10.md change 5)

TestPreserveAndEligibility::test_hklm_is.note: case: an all-users registration is not native eligible; also test_prepare.cpp "an all-users registration is sent to the setup before anything is staged" and tests/update/test_apply.cpp "an all-users install is never prepared natively"

TestPreserveAndEligibility::test_elevate.note: case: an elevated process is not native eligible. The rule; reading the process token (standard_user_process in win/installed_transaction.cpp) is Windows glue no test fakes

TestCommitAndRecover::test_swap_and_clea.note: case: a prepared update is swapped in, confirmed by the new version and cleaned up (off Windows, with a script standing in for the new version); the swap alone is test_transaction.cpp "native transaction persists intent before each rename and confirms health"

TestCommitAndRecover::test_recover_prepa.note: case: recovering a prepared transaction retires it without touching the installation (FioriVoce's final state is superseded: nothing was moved); the candidate goes in test_startup_recovery.cpp "a finished transaction is collected by the next start"

TestCommitAndRecover::test_tampered_cand.note: case: a candidate changed after its preparation is rejected before the swap; the algorithm alone is test_transaction.cpp "a candidate that no longer verifies is refused before anything moves"

TestCommitAndRecover::test_unconfirmed_n.note: case: an unconfirmed new tree without a rollback keeps its recovery entry

TestLiveParent::test_parent_that_never_e.reason: Deliberate difference a16-parent-exit (docs/port/differences.md): FioriVoce never ends a parent that outlasts the wait; the update stops and the application is left open. Its own rule: tests/update_native/test_transaction.cpp "invalid journal or a live parent cannot start a native swap" and test_transaction_runner.cpp "a commit refused because the application is still open moves and starts nothing".

TestLiveParent::test_this_process_is_nev.reason: Deliberate difference a16-parent-exit (docs/port/differences.md): FioriVoce never ends a parent that outlasts the wait; the update stops and the application is left open. The test pins _force_close_pid, which has no counterpart: no process is ever ended by its number; the only one the helper stops is the health-check child it created itself (src/update_native/detail/health_child.h).

TestLiveParent::test_an_unidentified_par.reason: Deliberate difference a16-parent-exit (docs/port/differences.md): FioriVoce never ends a parent that outlasts the wait; the update stops and the application is left open. The test pins _force_close_pid, which has no counterpart. An unidentified parent is not even waited for: tests/update_native/test_parent_process.cpp "parent process wait verifies current image and creation time" and test_journal.cpp "journal parent identity is bound to an independently trusted executable".

TestPrepareCandidate::test_stale_registe.note: case: a stale registered version does not stop a native update; the commit's registry write is counted in test_native_platform.cpp "a prepared update is swapped in, confirmed by the new version and cleaned up" (the real DisplayVersion write is test_private_registry.cpp, Windows only, not run here)

TestPrepareCancel::test_cancel_after_ext.note: case: a cancel after the extraction still cancels and leaves nothing behind

TestLockedFiles::test_an_ordinary_error_.note: case: an ordinary error is not retried

TestLockedFiles::test_hashing_the_app_it.note: case: authenticating the installation waits out a lock on the application that just closed (off Windows the lock is simulated; the Windows branch, which holds the image without sharing, was not run here)

TestLockedFiles::test_cleanup_waits_out_.reason: FioriVoce has no cleanup copy of the updater and no --cleanup-transaction mode: a finished transaction is collected in the helper's own run and by the application's next start, once the updater has released its gates (docs/port/differences.md a16-cleanup). tests/update_native/test_startup_recovery.cpp "a finished transaction waits for the updater that still holds the update gate".

TestAbandonedTransactions::test_a_transa.reason: Deliberate difference a16-cleanup (docs/port/differences.md): FioriVoce never collects by age; a transaction folder without a journal is left for inspection. tests/update_native/test_startup_recovery.cpp "a transaction folder that cannot be read or has no journal is left alone".

TestAbandonedTransactions::test_a_finish.note: case: a finished transaction is collected by the next start

TestAbandonedTransactions::test_a_transa.note: case: a transaction recovery may still need is kept

TestAbandonedTransactions::test_an_unrea.note: case: a transaction folder that cannot be read or has no journal is left alone

TestLaunchDirectory::test_the_restarted_.reason: PyInstaller onefile plumbing: the bootloader parent keeps the launch directory, so the frozen helper restarts itself from the updates root. A native program is one process and only changes directory (docs/port/packages/M10.md change 7).

test_retired_transaction_cannot_run_afte.note: case: a transaction retired for setup can no longer run

test_preparing_journal_is_collected_afte.note: case: a preparation whose application died is abandoned and collected

test_health_process_exit_fails_without_w.note: case: a health process that exits fails without waiting for the timeout (the shared wait over the POSIX child; the same case over the Windows child is [platform] and was not run here)

test_cleanup_failure_is_not_reported_as_.note: case: a cleanup failure is not reported as an update failure (cleanup is part of the helper's one run; there is no cleanup process)
